coverage_statement: Works with at least one UC Berkeley-affiliated authorship, publication year 2024, and an OpenAlex abstract.
construction_notes: The live response was requested without an API key.
The fixture preserves the OpenAlex list-response shape: meta, results, and group_by.
To keep the teaching fixture small, each result retains only the authorship entry containing institution I95457486; selected root fields and each full abstract_inverted_index are preserved.
No API key, email address, request header, or personal local path is stored.
OpenAlex metadata can change after retrieval; this tracked fixture is the deterministic classroom and grading fallback.
